training.selection: February 5-fold grouped CV only; no March labels used for hyperparameter/model selection
training.predeadline_features: ordered second/third lane identities; each candidate own/relative national ST, national win/2/3, local win/2, motor2/3, boat2; boat3 gaps; pair gaps/means; inner/outer/mixed indicators and pair-specific interaction terms

interpretation: Wave57 pair-level February-trained interaction modeling improves both compact 3-ticket capture and diagnostic ROI versus Wave55 on the frozen March Wave54 population. Unlike Wave56, the gain comes from ordered-pair-specific inner/outer and strength/ST/motor interactions rather than a race-level prior. Early and late halves both improve by one hit. March is research-exposed, so this is diagnostic evidence only and not sufficient for production promotion.
